properties.otherAdvice:
Vehicles between 15 and 28 tonnes are now able to access the valley with Council permission, under stop/slow conditions.

As the area remains a construction site, safety procedures must be followed.

For vehicles between 15 and 28 tonnes to access the site:

  • Please email the Manager Transport and Public Access, Nicole Hume at nhume@bmcc.nsw.gov.au with at least two working days’ notice to obtain a permit for the heavy vehicle access.
  • A permit will be required to be carried and shown to traffic control on site. Traffic controllers will then coordinate access through the site.

Please note that if the same vehicle needs to access the valley multiple times, only one permit will be required. Vehicles over 15 tonnes that are not scheduled to enter the valley will be turned back to ensure safety is maintained on site.
Snowy 2.0 construction vehicles only will be allowed access.

Light vehicles:

  • Olympic Hwy and Silo Rd.

Heavy vehicles up to 26m operating at HML (including PBS 2A):

  • Divert via Cootamundra and Stockinbingal, using the Olympic Hwy, Stockinbingal Rd, and Burley Griffin Way. This will add around 20 minutes to the trip. Residents can use local roads.

Heavy vehicles longer than 26m (including PBS 2B+, Class 1 OSOM vehicles, and special purpose vehicles, including cranes):

  • Divert via Temora using Goldfields Way/Olympic Hwy to Wagga Wagga, then Sturt Hwy/Edward St to the Hume Hwy in both directions. This will add around 90 minutes to the trip.

Operators of Class 1, 2 and 3 vehicles:

  • If travelling under a notice, must consult their relevant enforceable network map to confirm a suitable approved alternate route.
  • If travelling under a permit, must not travel off the approved route listed in the permit unless an updated permit is obtained from the NHVR.
